notes: The batch rows had no id field, so each match.group_id is a slug derived from the name; the importer should confirm the slugs. The WebSearch budget (6 of 6) is used up. The String Band Association site did not resolve (phillystringbandassociation.com), so there was no association list for the 14 string bands. Records: 27, all verdict publish: 15 batch units (14 string bands and Golden Sunrise), 10 Fancy Brigades from the Fancy Brigade Association's member brigades page, 1 record for the Fancy Brigade Association, and 1 record for Pennsport String Band (a lead found in search results, not in the batch, with its own site). Status for most batch units rests on the 2026 parade lineup, since their own sites show no dated events; only Aqua String Band, Greater Kensington String Band and Uptown String Band have their own dated 2026 items. Duffy, Fralinger, Jersey and Woodland have no own website found. Avenuers, Golden Crown and Spartans link only to Facebook, which was not read, so their status is unknown. Parade-site Instagram links are recorded as social contacts and not read. Pennsport is not in the 2026 official lineup. Leads not checked: Palandro-Ferry Memorial Foundation (no own website known) and Greater Overbrook String Band (no own website found).
